data_sources.description: List of location providers (e.g., GPS, network, cellular) with settings

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds before provider fails (optional)

default_accuracy.description: Default accuracy level for location requests: 'high', 'medium', or 'low'

privacy_mode.description: Enable privacy mode — redact location data in logs and API responses

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed

polling_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between passive location updates (e.g., Wi-Fi scanning)

allowed_countries.description: Whitelist of allowed countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes); empty = all countries

location_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached location entries

geoclue_service.description: D-Bus service name for the Geoclue2 backend (if used)
